decisions.statement: A local-first demo studio where users can compose, save, and export productions, complete guided workshops, and document releases offline.
decisions.rationale: Beginners and independent makers need to compose, preview, save, and export a demoscene production completely offline, without encountering specialists setup barriers or cloud dependencies.

decisions.statement: Use one stable task-oriented design route per declared task.
decisions.rationale: The plan establishes a deterministic route contract; the generation adapter remains responsible for collision-safe target-router integration.

decisions.statement: No brand or content asset is required by the brief. Do not invent decorative assets; record any later need before generation.
decisions.rationale: Asset scope follows declared brand and content requirements rather than decorative defaults.

tokenRequirements.rule: Define theme-specific semantic roles with contrast and non-color state cues.
Use stable readable roles with no viewport-width font scaling or negative letter spacing.
Use a finite spacing scale that preserves grouping and responsive rhythm.
Use restrained component geometry and a distinct focus treatment.
Motion must communicate state and provide a reduced-motion equivalent.
Chart roles must remain distinguishable without color and preserve source and freshness context.

implementationStages.name: Validate downstream contracts
implementationStages.exitCondition: All applicable product-task, trust, information, and design contracts pass.

implementationStages.name: Confirm target architecture
implementationStages.exitCondition: Routes, component boundaries, state owners, and target repository conventions are confirmed.

implementationStages.name: Define semantic tokens
implementationStages.exitCondition: Primitive, semantic, and component token layers cover every declared role and theme.

implementationStages.name: Implement the primary task and recovery
implementationStages.exitCondition: The smallest coherent task path covers success, failure, disclosure, and recovery.

implementationStages.name: Run automated verification
implementationStages.exitCondition: Static, contract, integration, and browser evidence satisfies every automated obligation.

implementationStages.name: Complete attributable human review
implementationStages.exitCondition: Only criteria explicitly requiring human evidence have attributable reviewer records.

verificationObligations.expectedEvidence: Browser report with applicable accessibility checks passing.

limitations: A compiled plan proves deterministic transformation and declaration traceability, not product desirability, target-repository compatibility, rendered quality, or runtime correctness.
Provisional decisions require the stated downstream contract or target-architecture evidence before implementation begins.
Human-expert and representative-user obligations remain evidence requirements. Compilation does not create or satisfy human attestations.
